hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I'm Haley Reeder, an instructional designer focused on sales and partner enablement for complex products. I design the learning experience and can also work with LMS operations, reporting, automation, AI evaluation, or custom development when the project needs it.

featured_intro.label: Featured work introduction
featured_intro.value: The portfolio is organized around instructional design, AI evaluation, and the systems I use to build and maintain learning.

hero_title.label: About hero title
hero_title.value: Learning design, development, and the systems around it

hero_intro_primary.label: Primary introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I design enterprise learning for sales and partner audiences, especially when the subject is technical or product-heavy. My work also reaches into LMS operations, reporting, automation, AI evaluation, and custom digital content when those pieces are part of the learning problem.

hero_intro_secondary.label: Background paragraph
hero_intro_secondary.value: Before corporate L&D, I taught high school history and English. That classroom experience and my Master of Education still shape how I think about practice, feedback, assessment, and whether learning actually changes performance.

thread_heading.label: Common thread heading
thread_heading.value: How I adapt the work to the learning need

thread_intro.label: Common thread introduction
thread_intro.value: Different formats solve different problems. Select a project type to see what I pay attention to when I design it and what evidence I use to judge whether it works.

hero_intro.label: Projects hero introduction
hero_intro.value: Browse instructional design, AI evaluation, and learning-systems work. The examples show both the finished experience and the thinking behind it.

family_intro.label: Project types introduction
family_intro.value: Open a category to see the project examples and interactive demos inside it.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design around the performance people need on the job, then choose the content, practice, support, and measurement that fit the task.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I begin with the learner, the performance need, and the business context before choosing a format. The goal is to build the smallest effective solution that supports the required performance.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: The format depends on the task. Sometimes a focused interaction or reference tool is enough; other needs call for multimedia, assessment, or a full learning pathway.

examples_intro.label: Examples introduction
examples_intro.value: Browse examples ranging from focused interactions to multimedia and complete learning pathways.

hero_intro_primary.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I evaluate AI-generated work against task requirements, source evidence, and quality standards rather than surface fluency alone.

hero_intro_secondary.label: Hero supporting paragraph
hero_intro_secondary.value: I review model outputs for accuracy, grounding, instruction adherence, and usefulness, then write feedback tied to the evidence.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: Evaluation starts with requirements and evidence

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: A polished response can still be inaccurate, incomplete, unsupported, or misaligned with the task.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: Before scoring an output, I identify the task, audience, approved source material, and constraints. I then check whether the response actually meets them.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: I separate material quality issues from stylistic preference and focus feedback on problems that affect correctness, usefulness, or reliability.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design and automate the processes that support learning work so development, LMS administration, reporting, and maintenance are easier to repeat and own.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I use documented workflows to make design decisions, handoffs, reviews, and development easier to follow and repeat.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: I automate repetitive work and connect content to LMS or reporting systems when that reduces manual effort. I use AI only where it improves the workflow without removing human review.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: I document how the system works, who owns it, and what data shows where it needs improvement.

areas_intro.label: Workflow areas introduction
areas_intro.value: Browse examples of the operating work behind learning design and delivery.

hero_intro.value: LinkedIn is the easiest way to reach me. A protected portfolio contact form is also in development.

connect_intro.label: Connect card introduction
connect_intro.value: I'm interested in instructional design roles and projects where learning, technology, AI, or enablement overlap.
